limitations: Input currentness and stable provenance do not verify generated claims. Current automatic context still excludes recaps. Generic conclusion/claim validators and evidence-preserving handoffs remain open.
Direct recap calls lack durable pre-provider admission; process death before a local outcome receipt or loss of an unsaved report can leave an unknown external outcome. Never blindly replay it.

Registered application-file unlink and SQLite cache scrubbing are not forensic device, snapshot or backup erasure. Original source archives remain under their existing revision window; archive expiry/hard forgetting/receipt compaction remain open.

Recap listing fails explicitly above 128 artifacts/64 MiB/4096 directory entries or the 128-input union. It is not unbounded archival scaling.
